title: AUTHORITY_GRANT
description: Permission to take one bounded action, for a limited time. Never a standing capability - a grant that does not expire is a credential.

delegatedBy.description: The accountable human standing behind it. Both facts belong in the record: which agent acted, and who authorised it.

conditions.description: What must remain true. A grant whose conditions stopped holding has lapsed, whether or not it expired.

scope.description: The narrowest set of targets that makes the action possible.
